system.description:
Built on Project FU's Isekai Fantasy Atlas.

PROPRIETOR SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000197]{Incorporate} 【Max SL 5】

Incorporate an organisation — one at a time. Once per session, use one organisational ability as a free action on your turn by spending 1 IP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000198]{Dividends} 【Max SL 4】

Spend 1 IP to activate an organisational ability as a free action, (SL) times per session — in addition to Incorporate's single free use.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000199]{Bargain} 【Max SL 3】

Personal purchases cost (SL × 10%) less; personal payments and rewards pay (SL × 10%) more. At GM discretion it also bends narrative expense and reward, or grants +(SL) to related Checks — read as transactions only.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000200]{Deep Pockets} 【Max SL 5】

Once per conflict scene, as part of an action, spend up to (SL × 200) zenit before rolling: +1 per 200 spent, narratively explained. Kept — it makes the price of privilege legible, out loud. Counts toward the two-effect cap.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000201]{Endless Supply} 【Max SL 1】

Once per conflict scene, take the Inventory action to restore up to 2 IP, divided between up to two creatures including yourself.
